3 DOSAGE FORMS AND STRENGTHS MultiHance is a sterile, nonpyrogenic, clear, colorless, aqueous solution for intravenous use only, containing 529 mg gadobenate dimeglumine per mL. Each mL of MultiHance Injection contains 529 mg gadobenate dimeglumine and is available in single use vials.
